Name: Elah, Son of Uzzi
Summary: Son of Uzzi son of Michri, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:8: Son of Uzzi son of Michri, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
